subject: cult-info-b
title: (C)CULT.INFO.B.------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 67 (WAM-9). The chart has no arrow; CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), the first title code, is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: STF (source transfer) and MT-INFO (multi-information); LANG-DY (language dynamics) is on a dotted line from the subject. From LANG-DY: RE-INT-TR. From STF: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance); RE-ST (restructuralism) is on a dotted line from STF. From RE-ST: POL-DY (political dynamics). EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is on a dotted line from PROG-CONT.
